svg.title: Smart Calculator — app icon (concept E3)
svg.desc: Split background: dollar over cream on top, Bs in amber over deep blue below. Full bleed on purpose — iOS and Android apply their own corner mask. Colors come from the app's glass token set: cream #F4F1EC is keyOpaqueFill, #141B24 is backgroundBottom, amber #FAC775 is the accent reserved for bolivars.

g.font-family: SF Pro Display, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
